checks.title: Confirm handoff goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name Sales and receiving CS owners, the first reviewable accepted or blocked result, and excluded provisioning, CRM and customer-contact actions.

checks.title: Bind the exact customer and opportunity
checks.instructions: Record tenant, CRM account, opportunity, customer account, contract ID and revision; reject similarly named accounts and duplicate handoff keys.

checks.title: Verify signed scope and provisioning rule
checks.instructions: Read the executed agreement and approved purchased scope. Reconcile CRM Closed Won, sales notes, entitlement and policy; keep unresolved promises blocked.

checks.title: Agree on the first-value promise
checks.instructions: Record the approved goal, observable first-value rule, target date and source. A generic onboarding checklist or sign-in is insufficient.

checks.title: Bind Sales and CS Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect compatible Deal Follow-through Coordinator and Customer Onboarding Coordinator Crews and existing first-value route; reuse or propose reviewed creation with exact IDs and access.

checks.title: Probe CRM, agreement and entitlement
checks.instructions: Read one authorized exact-object record from each source or bounded export, record revisions and observation times, and show missing access or contradictory values.

checks.title: Validate both artifacts
checks.instructions: Insert blocking script steps for sales-cs-handoff/v1 and onboarding-acceptance/v1, then prove wrong account, changed contract, duplicate key and false acceptance stop the route.

checks.title: Review the concrete Builder plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, data boundary, source paths, validator, owner acceptance, first-value handoff, retries, manual route, optional event policy and cost before applying.

checks.title: Run one real manual handoff and blocked control
checks.instructions: Save authorized source reads, artifacts, validator result, receiving-owner decision and an unresolved case. Fictional fixtures do not complete this check.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A CRM or contract event requires authenticated identity, current re-read, stable handoff key, duplicate handling, owner review and notification policy.
